name: Dal Makhani (Black Lentils in Cream Curry)
whyItWorks: Whole black urad lentils and kidney beans simmered for hours with butter, heavy cream, garlic, ginger, and chili. The dense bean skins resist upper-GI digestion and rapidly ferment in the colon, producing severe gas, pressure, and diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Gas & Stricture Warning: Avoid black lentils and kidney beans. Choose yellow moong dal (well pureed) or plain basmati rice with tandoori chicken.
